description: Which QL-API endpoint fits this task. POST a task description and get the ranked endpoint(s) that best match, each with a confidence label (high/medium/low). Deterministic keyword matching over this platform's own endpoint catalog, no LLM. Pairs with model_advisor (which itself is one of the recommendable endpoints, so a "which model" task surfaces it) - call them independently and chain the results yourself; optionally pass a prior model_advisor result's rationale in as `context` to bias matching.

context.description: Optional extra text to fold into matching - e.g. a prior model_advisor rationale, or more detail than fits in `task`.

task.description: What you are trying to do.

tools.description: Optional allowlist - restrict matching to only these endpoints, by endpoint slug ("humanize") or MCP tool name ("humanize_text").

top_n.description: How many ranked endpoints to return. Default 1 = best match only.

name: tool_advisor
